new_value: InMemoryCache recovers poisoned locks with PoisonError::into_inner rather than mapping poisoning to a miss and a dropped write. Sound because the only operations held under these locks are HashMap insert/get/remove/len over derived Hash+Eq on Vec<u8> and Option<String>, none of which can panic part-way and leave a map half-updated, so the poisoned flag cannot mean the map is inconsistent. Panicking was rejected: it would push an unrelated thread's failure into path validation, where the cache is meant to be a transparent optimisation. Also removes an ambiguity in put_crl_if_not_rollback, whose false return meant both 'suppressed as a rollback' and 'lock broken, stored nothing'. Two tests poison the locks deliberately and assert the cache still round-trips. Commit 9c381db8.
